text:
maria: Quick note — I ran the contrastive-v2 embed model through the k=10 holdout probe this morning and the numbers are weird.
jin: What weird? drop across all segments or a specific bucket?
maria: Overall Recall@10 is 0.62 vs baseline 0.79 from contrastive-v1. Silhouette dropped from 0.41 -> 0.21. :confused:
owen: Oof. Did you run with the int8 quantization profile we tested last week?
maria: Yes — the CI job used the new int8 per-tensor profile (compress-quant:fast). Eval command:
```
python eval_recall.py --model contrastive-v2 --holdout holdout_A --k 10 --quant int8 --seed 42
```
liz: Do you have NN ID-flip rate? That usually flags embedding permutation problems.
eval-bot: nn_id_flip: 0.184; recall@1: 0.41; recall@5: 0.53; recall@10: 0.62; avg_cosine_shift: -0.037
maria: nn flip ~18% seems high. Baseline flip for v1-int8 was ~4%. Also see cluster merge metric: 12% more merges than baseline.
jin: Could be quantization-induced rotation/scale change. Did we apply any post-quant re-centering or norm rescale? 
maria: No post-rescale. The pipeline applies symmetric per-tensor quant with clip to max abs. No re-centering.
owen: Try per-channel quant and asymmetric zero-point, and also a float16 run to isolate quant as cause. I'll queue both.
liz: Also run label-holdout by category — the degradation may be concentrated in long-tail classes.
jin: Agreed. I'll run per-channel int8 and float16 switchover. Hypothesis: per-tensor quant collapses dimensions carrying contrastive signals.
maria: Can you include a small diagnostic script to compute top-k NN overlap and cosine distribution before/after? Something like:
```
# compare top-k overlap
python compare_topk.py --ref embeddings_v1.npy --new embeddings_v2.npy --k 10 --out overlap.json
```

jin: Yep. Adding that. Will also produce UMAP + per-class recall table.
eval-bot: queued job 2209: eval-perchannel-int8 (ETA ~45m)
eval-bot: queued job 2210: eval-fp16 (ETA ~50m)
liz: If per-channel fixes it, we should update the quant profile in model-configs and add the NN-overlap smoke check to onboarding.
maria: Agreed. Filing a tracking issue so we don't lose context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/embeddings/issues/2345
owen: FYI I looked at the training config — contrastive loss temp was 0.08 in v2 vs 0.07 in v1. Small but might interact with quant noise. I'll try a tiny temp sweep too.
jin: Good call. Also will test zero-mean re-centering before quant as a quick mitigation.
maria: Thanks all. If the per-channel run recovers recall to >=0.75 we can consider the profile change; otherwise rollback to fp16 by default for GA.
liz: tagging oncall @jin for visibility. :eyes:
maria: I'll post the UMAP snapshots in #eng-ml once they finish. For now, assigning follow-ups: @jin run per-channel + fp16 + overlap script; @owen run temp-sweep and per-class holdout; @liz update onboarding checklist if per-channel passes.
jin: on it.
owen: starting sweeps.
liz: noted.
maria: thanks — will check back after eval-bot posts results.
